learned_commands.description: Move to and remain at the handler's side.
Watch and defend a specified location, object, or person.
Follow a given scent, sound, or sight cue.
Chase and harry a specified target without engaging lethally.
Break from current task and come back to handler.
Engage a specified target with natural weapons.
Bring a specified object to the handler.
Move forward along the current path, observe, and return if threat is detected.
Maintain position and resist movement until released.
